_about: The living city: what changed in Adyta today. Every player's PDA builds the same day from the Adyta date, so the whole group sees the same moods, signs and hidden Sticker. All lines here are drafts by Eko (status: draft) and go to Nib with the next canon handoff. Logic: apps/cityday.js.

moods: The Mercy Street fryers started early. So did the bass.
Half the block lost power at noon and nobody noticed until the music stopped.
Someone repainted the Soft Border line overnight. It moved two meters.
Quiet for Low Halo, which means only two arguments and one band.
A Crownline van parked on Mercy Street and got a ticket from a goblin.
The Saint Static Arms elevator made a noise. Residents are treating it as a rumor.
Rain on the tin awnings, and a queue outside the Grit Pit anyway.
Posters went up over the posters that went up over the posters.
wisdom: If the streetlight flickers twice, the wiring's local. Three times, it's Crownline.
Tip the door, not the bartender. The door remembers.
Fixed it yourself? Don't tell the landlord.
The fryer queue knows the news before Velvet does.
Never stand under the third-floor balconies on laundry day.
Rent's due Monday. Excuses are due Sunday.
A borrowed amp comes back louder or not at all.
Every map of this place is wrong. Ask who drew it.

moods: The incense is thick today. Somebody is hiding a smell.
Three contract lawyers were seen laughing. Nobody knows what they signed.
The courtyard lamps stayed lit past dawn again.
A stall changed hands overnight. The new owner already looks tired.
Quiet bargaining. Loud receipts.
A curse inspector is walking the arcade with a clipboard and a sense of dread.
Every fortune teller predicted rain. It's sunny. They're raising prices.
Someone's selling lucky ink. The ink disagrees.
wisdom: Read the receipt before the receipt reads you.
If the price is a favor, ask whose.
Never thank a fae vendor out loud. Nod.
Salt in the left pocket, credits in the right.
The second signature is where they get you.
A free sample is a down payment.
Bells on the door mean the shopkeeper's listening. No bells means something else is.
Cold ink, warm hands. Never the other way round.

moods: Festival bunting went up early. Somebody's cousin is getting married.
The spice lane smells like an argument about saffron.
Delivery bikes everywhere. The trucks are stuck at the docks again.
A family stall is closed for a funeral. The neighbors are running it for them.
Prices are up two credits and everyone is pretending not to notice.
Lunch rush hit early and stayed.
Kids running a lemonade stand with a better margin than Velvet Signal.
A courtyard concert, unlicensed, very well attended.
wisdom: Buy from the grandmother, not the grandson.
The back lanes close at dusk. The back-back lanes don't.
Haggle with a smile. Haggle twice with food.
If a stall has no sign, it's for regulars.
Pay cash in the Ring. Cards remember.
Everyone here is related. Be polite.
The last stall before the tram stop has the honest scale.
A free meal at a family table means you're helping with dishes.

moods: Fog off the water and three ships nobody expected.
The cranes are running double shifts. The crews are running on coffee.
A container fell open overnight. Half the docks are pretending they didn't see inside.
Gulls fighting over a fish cart. The gulls are winning.
The shift bell rang twice. One of those was a joke.
The tide's high and the tempers are higher.
A crew lodging is throwing a farewell for someone shipping out.
Quiet water, loud bars.
wisdom: Never ask what's in the crate. Ask what it weighs.
The harbor master's mood sets the price of everything.
Crews look after crews. Everyone else gets the weather.
When the fog's thick, the cameras are blind, and the wardens know it.
Tip the crane operator. You'll want a favor someday.
A sailor's map is honest about water and nothing else.
Lodging rent goes up when the contract ends. It always does.
Bring your own rope.

moods: Every payphone on the block rang at once at noon. Nobody answered.
A broker set up a folding table and a line formed.
New faces on the corner. Old faces watching them.
Two crews shook hands on something. Everyone is guessing what.
Rumor says someone is hiring. Rumor always says that.
A debt got called in loudly outside the noodle bar.
Quiet, the kind that means everyone's on the phone.
Runners in and out all day. Something's moving.
wisdom: Whoever introduces you owns a little piece of you.
A favor is a loan with no paperwork.
If the job sounds easy, ask who said no.
The payphones work because someone pays for them. Find out who.
Shake with the right hand. Count your fingers after.
Names here are for sale. Don't drop yours.
Half up front. Always.
A broker smiling at you is working.

moods: The gardeners are out in force. Someone important is visiting.
A gate stood open for an hour. Nobody walked through it.
Old money is wearing new jewelry. Someone sold something.
Moonspire House is hosting. The guest list is a secret everyone knows.
The street sweepers swept the street twice.
A carriage-house light was on all night.
Very quiet. Expensive quiet.
Private security changed shifts and changed uniforms.
wisdom: The staff entrance is the real entrance.
Never compliment an heirloom. Ask its name.
Here the gossip is old and the grudges are older.
A closed gate is an invitation to the wrong people.
Bring a gift. Bring a better excuse.
The gardeners know everything and say nothing.
Titles here are older than the city's paperwork.
If they offer tea, the meeting is already over.

moods: A new bridge went up between two roofs. A goblin is charging a toll.
Somebody's patch grid is humming louder than usual.
A route argument is happening on three rooftops at once.
Washing lines across every gap. Laundry day.
Gremlin Works dragged something big up the stairs. It's still twitching.
A rooftop garden grew its first tomato. There's a party.
Fog in the alleys, sun on the roofs.
Patchkin crews are re-marking the routes after the rain.
wisdom: If the stair's warm, someone's below it.
Ask before you cross a roof. Ask twice for the third one.
Bad stairs are free. Good stairs cost a favor.
A route marked twice is a route someone argued about.
Don't touch the wires with ribbons on them.
Bring snacks. Directions here are traded, not given.
Rooftops are faster. Manners are fastest.
If a goblin says it holds, it holds. If they shrug, run.

moods: Radio Sewers is playing the archive tapes again. Smokier's still out.
The water's low and the echoes are wrong.
A new stall opened in a dry junction.
The rats are calm today. Good sign.
Antitoxin crews in masks. Nobody's saying why.
Someone chalked a new arrow, and three people already disagree with it.
Warm air coming up from below. Not the usual warm.
Mercury's on air early, complaining about the surface.
wisdom: If the rat is nervous, be nervous.
Follow the chalk, not the signs.
Keep your voice down near the old junctions.
Surface boots get noticed. Wet boots get respect.
The tunnels listen. Talk kindly about them.
Turn your light down near the sleepers.
A dry route today is a river tomorrow.
Radio's on, things are fine. Radio's off, find the exit.

moods: The pressure doors moved. Nobody moved them.
A maintenance light blinked a pattern all night.
The air tastes like old pennies today.
Footsteps on the map that nobody made.
Something maintained the pipes overnight. Badly.
Quiet, in a way the walls seem proud of.
A sealed door has fresh scratches. On the inside.
The clocks at the lower junctions are five minutes off. All of them, the same five minutes.
wisdom: If the map agrees with you, check again.
Don't follow the arrows that look new.
Count the doors going in. Count them coming out.
Bring two lights. Leave neither behind.
If you hear maintenance, leave.
Nobody honest works down here. Including you.
The pipes learned. Don't teach them more.
Tell someone up top when you'll be back.

moods: Exam week. The Index Court is full of people trading references they don't have.
The Brass Observatory left its dome open all night. Nobody admits to the star chart on the fountain.
Charter Gate's queue reaches the fountain. Credentials are being checked twice.
The Engineering Yard tripped the block's power. The Arcane Labs did not notice.
A lecture spilled out of the East Teaching Halls and kept going in the street.
The Secondhand Quill has a sale on paper and a surcharge on margins.
wisdom: Bring two copies of everything. The Registrar keeps one.
Never ask a scholar what they're working on unless you have an hour.
The Labs and the Yard don't share power. Don't ask them to.
The Long Archive will find it. Eventually.
Annotations cost more than the book. They're worth it.
Student Quarters rent is cheaper if your paperwork is current. It isn't.

moods: Another crane went up overnight. The skyline has opinions.
The Velvet Window is showing a version of the city with no Low Halo in it.
Old Lease Court got another buyout letter. Someone pinned it to the door with a fork.
Tram's on time, which in New Halo means it left early.
The Ninth Floor has a waitlist for the waitlist.
Rain on the glass towers, and the umbrellas are all the same brand.
wisdom: Service Shift Gate opens before the residents wake. So should you.
The Last Original Cafe remembers prices. Ask what coffee used to cost.
If a door has no handle, it's not for you.
The Soft Border moves. Check where it is today.
Polished frontage, delivery doors underneath. Use the second one.
Never sign anything in Glassline Walk without reading the back.

moods: The Appeals Walk queue folds around the square twice.
Registry Counter's stamp broke. Everything today is 'pending'.
Advocates Steps are packed: someone's eviction hearing is at noon.
The Duplicate ran out of toner. The clerks are copying by hand and by mood.
A wrong form went to the Evidence Annex. Nobody can get it back.
Response Court ran a drill. Half the queue thought it was real.
wisdom: Bring every notice. Even the ones you threw away.
Duplicate everything. The originals go missing.
Advocates Steps first, Registry second. Never the other way round.
A queue that isn't moving is still a queue. Don't lose your place.
Back File Passage is faster, if you know a clerk.
If the form says 'optional', fill it in anyway.

moods: Inspection vans circled the loop three times before anyone got to work.
Meter House pushed an update. Half of Low Halo's lights flickered.
Contractor Muster is busy. Bastion's hiring again.
Switchyard Twelve hummed a new note all morning.
The Clean Front polished its counters. The queue did not get shorter.
Overtime Canteen ran out of the only good dish by ten.
wisdom: Paperwork starts at the Certification Gate. So does the waiting.
Watch the cables on Maintenance Cut. They're live more often than they say.
Nobody gets free minutes at the Overtime Canteen.
A disputed connection is still a connection. For now.
Bastion bodies at the Muster aren't on your side, even when they're polite.
Read the meter yourself. Then read the bill.

moods: The Mended Bell rang thirteen. The keepers say it rang twelve.
Petition Steps are crowded with quiet requests and louder families.
Laundry Yard has every line full. Someone's been admitted.
The Unnamed Court's door was open for a minute. Nobody went in.
Rain Cistern is full; the courtyard is singing.
Monastery Market has good bread and better gossip.
wisdom: Ask the keepers nothing directly. They answer sideways.
The Quiet Table feeds you without many questions. Return the favor.
Visitors use the North Gate. Deliveries go round the back.
Don't count the spires out loud.
The Infirmary takes you in when it can. Sometimes it can't.
If the bell rings wrong, stay indoors.

moods: Gardeners are out on the Kept Garden at dawn, paid by the hour, watched by the century.
Canopy Steps are quiet even for the Enclave.
Old Ward House hummed. Nobody remembers turning anything on.
The Shielded Service Yard had a delivery van stuck at the gate for an hour.
Someone repaired a brick on Pale Brick Walk. It's an event.
Cistern Court's pumps are running smooth; the water tastes old.
wisdom: Speak softly in the Enclave. They've heard everything already.
The Gardeners Table feeds the workers. Ask nicely and it feeds you too.
Heritage has plumbing. It also has a waitlist for the plumber.
Never sign the Long Lease in a hurry.
The service lanes are separate for a reason. Keep wards and wires apart.
An elf's 'soon' is your 'next year'.

moods: Transfer Square trams bunched up again. Three at once, then none for an hour.
The Notice Wall got another revision. It contradicts this morning's.
Shift Market's smoke is thick: something good on the grill.
Commerce Steps are full of suits looking down at the crowd.
The Public Counter opened a fourth queue. It's for the other three.
Someone fell asleep on the Last Bench. Nobody moved them.
wisdom: Read the Notice Wall twice. It changes before you're done.
Roofline Cut is faster than the street if your knees agree.
The Last Bench is free. That's why it's full.
Ledger Arcade traders deal fair, if you count after them.
Delivery carts have right of way on Service Crossing. They think so, anyway.
Eat at Shift Market between shifts, not during.

moods: Barges backed up on Freight Reach; somebody's papers are wrong.
Runoff Mouth ran colors today. Nobody's swimming.
Tide Ledger is full of chalk: double shifts on the water.
The Brown Steps are underwater again, up to the third mark.
Debris Catch caught something worth arguing over.
Meridian's clerks at Manifest Quay are checking every crate.
wisdom: Don't stand downstream of Runoff Mouth.
The water leaves marks on the steps. Read them before you sit.
Check the Tide Ledger before you take a shift.
What floats to the Debris Catch belongs to whoever's fastest.
The Bent Crossing takes one cart at a time. Wait.
Papers meet cargo at the quay. Make sure yours match.

moods: Half-Hull Dock is a ship today. Tomorrow it might be a ship again.
Plate Cutters are loud enough to hear from Crane Alley.
Rivet Canteen has stew and a line out the door.
A whole hull went through Breakers Gate. Only the parts came out.
Launch Slip is clear; something big is going down it soon.
Second Sale Yard has new fittings. Ask where they came from twice.
wisdom: Look up in Crane Alley. Loads move overhead.
Hearing protection at the Plate Cutters. Seriously.
Crew Rooms are double-booked. Get there first.
Anything at Second Sale Yard costs half of what they say and twice what it's worth.
Keep the slope clear on the Launch Slip.
Breakers Gate lets parts out. Whole ships rarely leave.

moods: The Hot Seam is welding behind the shutters again. Sparks under the door.
Generator Court went dark for ten minutes and the whole Row swore at once.
Third Rattle Motors has a truck nobody can identify.
Aftershift Kitchen is serving the good noodles. Night crews only.
The Borrowed Spanner lent out its last torque wrench. Story pending.
No Receipt Devices is fixing a phone that shouldn't exist.
wisdom: Third Rattle diagnoses first. Credentials later, if ever.
Return a borrowed tool with a story, or don't come back.
Generator Court is shared power. Don't be the one who trips it.
No receipt, no refund, no questions.
Apprentices learn with somebody watching. Be the somebody, sometimes.
Conduit Mouth crews fit where you don't.

moods: Lamps lit along Settlement Row. Someone's moved in.
A new crack ran through Fallen Court overnight.
The Scavengers Rest has a sign up: no visitors today.
Somebody tried the Sealed Door again. It's still sealed.
Utility Crosscut pipes are dripping warm.
A new mark on the Last Legible Wall. Nobody admits to it.
wisdom: Ask before entering the Scavengers Rest.
Keep off the loose edges in Fallen Court.
The Sealed Door is sealed for a reason. Probably.
Three Foundations, three floors. Pick one and stay on it.
Read the old wall, but don't copy it out loud.
If the route ends, turn around. Don't make a new one.

moods: Pump Queue started before dawn. The water's slow today.
The Wash Lines are full; rain's due, and everyone's betting against it.
Last Busk Corner had a crowd till midnight.
The Late Pot's out of everything but soup. The soup is good.
Someone fixed another step on the Mended Stair.
Neighbors Gate is watching closely: a stranger's been asking around.
wisdom: Water before work. Join the queue early.
Neighbors Gate asks who knows you. Have an answer.
The Late Pot feeds the late shift. Don't take the last bowl.
The Dry Shelf keeps goods above the runoff. Keep yours there too.
Busk at the Corner and someone will throw you a coin, or a shoe.
Borrowed roofs need returned favors.

moods: Scrap Ridge shifted overnight. A whole path is gone.
Copper Rain is stripping a new spool. Sharp edges everywhere.
Tag Dispute is three hours deep over a single chalk mark.
The Running Engine started something that hasn't run in years.
Meal Tin has hot food and a queue of goblins.
Crane Shadow swung wide today. Everyone stood back.
wisdom: Stay outside the crane's swing.
Chalk your tag clear, or someone else will.
The Kept Pieces are small. The possibilities aren't.
Weighing Shade weighs fair. Mostly.
If the Patchkin say a pile's unsafe, believe them.
Second Life Yard sorts before disposal. Ask before you take.

moods: Dustwalker Camp has new tents. Someone came in from the hinterland.
The Mended Pump coughed and then kept going.
Seed Tin's trading small today; nobody's selling much.
Hunters Return is checking gear: something's moving out past Last Fence.
Shared Store got a delivery of patched tools.
Seamfield strips are green for once.
wisdom: Ask first at Dustwalker Camp.
Trade small at Seed Tin. Keep some back.
Past the Last Fence, the country decides.
Check your gear at Hunters Return before you head out.
The pump keeps the fields alive. Don't break it.
Hinterland Path goes somewhere. Nobody agrees where.

moods: Roadside Rest is full; the floor by the stove is taken too.
The Last Lit Post is out. Bring your own light.
Fringe Market prices changed twice before noon.
A cart broke a wheel at the Spare Wheel. Barter's hot.
Someone moved the Return Marker. Locals moved it back.
Crossing Shade is crowded with people waiting for nobody official.
wisdom: Beyond the Last Lit Post, bring your own light.
Nobody agrees where authority ends. Act like it hasn't.
The Spare Wheel trades parts by barter. Credits are a last resort.
Find the Return Marker on the way out. You'll need it on the way back.
Patched Gate is loose. That's not the same as open.
Fringe Market prices change daily. Buy early.

moods: Shift Bell rang; the furnaces didn't stop.
The Long Pour is running hot. Guards doubled.
Hazard Pay Steps have a line. Someone got hurt on the night shift.
Canteen Six has stew between furnace shifts.
The Knuckle Corner is tense. Nobody's saying who's in charge.
Load Road is jammed; freight's taking the wide turn slow.
wisdom: Claims begin after the injury. Report it before you go home.
Ashborn Workshop crews run on reputation. Earn yours.
Soot hurts. Use a mask.
Stay off the Knuckle Corner if you don't know who you answer to.
Canteen Six feeds you between shifts, not during.
The South Exit leads to Southport. Smoke follows.

moods: Mending Court has a pile of broken things and a crowd of hands.
Open Pot has food, because there's enough today.
The Small Stage had a poet and a heckler. Both were good.
Lightshare is splitting power fairly. Someone counted.
No Crown Workshop is lending tools, no titles needed.
The Spare Chair is free. So is the conversation.
wisdom: Bring what you can to Mending Court.
Open Pot feeds you when there's enough. Bring some when there's more.
Ask before moving through Neighbors Steps.
Broken doesn't mean finished at the Useful Shelf.
Common Gate opens with a conversation, not a crown.
Lightshare power is shared. Don't hog it.

moods: Ash fall heavy this morning. Visibility is short.
Dead Wind Reach is quiet. Too quiet.
The Black Pool's edge crept closer to the markers.
Somebody tried the Corroded Span. They came back the long way.
Silent Machinery made a sound.
The exclusion fence has a new hole.
wisdom: Turn back at Last Warning if you're not ready.
Don't trust the Corroded Span.
Keep clear of the Black Pool.
Return before visibility fails.
The markers go missing. Count them on the way out.
Nothing out here is maintained, including your luck.

moods: Chalk marks are fresh at the Last Known Landing.
Someone came back from past the Pressure Door. They're not talking.
Rations & Meals is open and the stew is warm.
Uncertain Crossing's rope is swaying with nobody on it.
Supply Depot restocked. Not with what you need.
A new collapse at the front. The route's shorter now.
wisdom: Leave a chalk mark at the landing. Someone will look for it.
Don't force the Pressure Door.
The stairs at Broken Descent stop before the floor.
Dashes mark a possible passage. Possible.
Eat at Rations & Meals before you go down, not after.
Leave the map unfinished. That's how you come back.

shop: Best fix of the week gets a discount.
food: Ask what's in it. We'll guess.
Pay for one, eat two, tell no one.
venue: Last night was a good night.

hints: Fresh paste on a wall somewhere in {district}.
Someone slapped a new sticker up in {district}. Go look.
Patchkin were out in {district} last night with a bucket of paste.
A new sticker in {district}, still wet.
stickers.clue: Fresh paste on the wall here. Someone's been sticking things.
stickers.notHere: Go there to peel it off the wall.
stickers.found: Peeled it off the wall. It's yours now.
